title: Wendigo frost nova: radius 18 and green crystals on owned rings only
summary: Enlarge the ring's radius from the authored 12 to 18 on both sides and tint the crystal particles dark emerald through per-renderer, per-slot MaterialPropertyBlock overrides that apply only to particles owned by a Sample-spawned ring. Shared materials, the vanilla prefab and the sequence asset list are never written. This is a Sample-specific recolour, not a generic public recolor API.

requirements.world: server world writes the radius and sends ownership; client world writes the radius on the replicated ring and restyles particles Before/After PresentationSystemGroup

context.ownership: the server sends each owned ring's NetworkId (index, generation, type) in a Sample packet (event id 0x536D4E76, magic 0x4E4F5631, radius); the client accepts only the expected ring prefab GUID and radius and records ownership keyed by that NetworkId
context.radius write: raw write of RingAoE_DataShared.EndRadius at byte offset +4 on both sides (offset from the installed dump; TypeInfo.ElementSize reads 0 on this interop and is not used)
context.particle identity: ParticleData output rows (96-byte stride, SequenceEntity at +0) correlated with the Entities array, the row's sequence walked up Attach.Parent (depth <= 8) to a registered ring, then the particle entity's managed ParticleSettings.gameObject
context.retention: a styled particle is kept by ECS entity (with version), SequencerParticle.TimeCreated and GameObject identity, with a 15 s bound, so the tint survives the end of sequence emission while the renderer is alive

initialization: Server: after spawning the ring (wendigo-frost-nova-ring), write EndRadius=18 and register the ring for the ownership packet.
Client: on the packet, record the NetworkId; Before presentation, find the replicated ring with that NetworkId and the expected prefab GUID and write EndRadius=18 on it.
Client, Before presentation: restore every property block written last frame (Restore()).

Client, After presentation: for each ParticleData row whose sequence resolves to an owned ring, capture the slot's original MaterialPropertyBlock, seed the edited block from the renderer-wide block when the slot block is empty, set _BaseColor/_EmissiveColor/_GroundTint/_Fresnel_Color, SetPropertyBlock(edited, slot).
Keep restyling retained particles after sequence output ends while their identities still match.
cleanup: Every frame: originals restored before presentation, then re-applied only to still-matching particles (source-inspected).
Unload/Detach: Restore() then clear all tracking (source-inspected; no readback).
Client world change: pending ownership and tracked particles cleared.
Bounds: 256 client rings, 256 styled particles, 1024 property blocks.

controls.limitations: Sample-specific: only material slots whose shader name equals the crystal shader are touched, through per-slot MaterialPropertyBlocks with originals retained. Not a generic recolour operation for other effects. The pale mist was never claimed to turn green. Renderer.material is never instantiated and sharedMaterial never written.

discovery.note: Owned rings located on the client by NetworkId + prefab GUID; five crystal renderer slots found per ring by shader name. sides client: NetworkId lookup and shader slots are client presentation.

playback.note: Restyled particles emitted for every dash ring in the recording. sides server+client: server-driven dash rings plus client restyle.

appearance.note: Green crystals during the burst and in the tail; both ring expansions visible in the 8.2 s clip. Mist remains pale blue/white (never claimed). Reproduced 2026-09-07 at +1/+2/+3 s. sides server+client: client crystal renderers plus the server-driven ring procedure.

controls.note: Radius 18 read back on both sides on every ring; crystal root scale (1,1,1); colour applied. Each is one tested value, not a range. sides server+client: EndRadius was read on both process sides.

gameplayHits.note: Whether radius 18 changes hits or damage area is untested, as are hits at all. sides server: hits would be a server Health/HitList observation if tested.

naturalCleanup.note: At rest the per-slot overrides are gone: 0 of 120 crystal-shader slots carry a property block and none is green; an untinted ring on the same pool renders default colours. sides client: property-block presence is a client renderer observation.

explicitCleanup.note: Scopes: (a) Restore() before presentation is verified at rest (A3). (b) Unload with a live tinted ring: observed-success. Primary: A9 (live-rig 20260907T105917Z-active-ring-unload, catalog-cases-5; same directory as ring L9). The Sample's ClearRings destroyed the live ring: FROSTDASH edge=Start with the ring id, exists true before removal, server-side Sample Removal, `FROSTDASH cleanup alive=1 destroyed=[<ring id>]`, exists false afterwards. Measured: an active ring observed at teardown, a destroy call for that id, and later absence. Not a completed-destruction latency; Start-to-unload timing is not that measurement. Teardown restored Sample before `.frostdash off` (handler `alive=0 destroyed=[]`). Historical: A7 and A8 (catalog-cases-4, 20260907T104023Z-active-ring-unload and 20260907T104052Z-active-ring-unload) recorded the same disposal proof with an admitted teardown gap (`.frostdash off` not handled because the plugin was on hold; frost dash stayed enabled; not part of the disposal observation). The ring's appearance restore at unload (Restore()) logs nothing and was not separately observed. (c) Detach Restore() path: source-inspected only (E4). sides server: unload readiness (A7/A8/A9) is a server Sample teardown observation; Restore() at rest is not a rig-run stamp claim.

poolReuse.note: Same-instance reuse demonstrated: after `.froststyle off`, the 10 previously tinted crystal slots (T) were active again untinted (R=T, retriesUsed=1, hasBlock=False, baseColor=none). Both readback and viewed visual evidence exist for the same identified reused slots (10 qualified). Primary: A11 (live-rig 20260908T051452Z-pool-reuse-identity, pool-reuse-visual-2; report status complete; T=10, R=10 on attempt 1, censusDelayMs 1500). report.json keeps visual.verified=false (unverified by the rig; the rig does not analyse pixels); the visual verdict is the reviewer's viewing recorded in that README (tinted frame green; reuse frames default ice-blue, no green). Historical: A10 (20260907T215010Z-pool-reuse-identity, catalog-cases-10) recorded the same T=R=10 readback without visual capture. A6 (20260907T084907Z-pool-reuse-identity) recorded 122 identical rendererId/goId pairs across baseline/+1.5 s/rest; that whole-scene comparison is not the pass proof. Earlier A3/A4 still hold (0 of 120 crystal-shader slots with a block at rest; untinted control ring default). No vanilla Wendigo cast was compared. The appearance restore at unload (Restore()) is still unobserved. The rig does not analyse pixels. sides server+client: client renderer identities plus the server-driven `.froststyle off` procedure (A11).
